title: Python and teacher connection checks
summary: Real Python execution and the updated teacher integration passed automated source checks.

changes.detail: Python shortcut and one-click teacher help with selected text or recent terminal transcript.
Teacher navigation now requests an explanation and prevents the terminal close callback from navigating away. New question parameters remount the teacher conversation.
Empty copy-example button is hidden when no example exists.

validation.name: Real runtime checks
validation.detail: 8 lab and terminal tests passed, including Python standard library, Unicode, errors, timeouts, variables and interactive input. Kali test skipped; node-pty emitted console cleanup diagnostics.

validation.name: App checks
validation.detail: TypeScript noEmit and focused ESLint on all four changed files passed.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Signed-in AI response and browser click-through not verified. Native phone not tested. Closing terminal for teacher help ends sessions; transcript is passed to teacher. Local PC/server required; no deployment.
